decision_origin: The user requested fixing the 40-cell pi0-FAST blocker. V3-A001 failed its release gate after distinct LEFT/RIGHT token bytes produced bit-identical actions.

known_before_freeze.historical_result: LEFT 1/10 and RIGHT 10/10 under unavailable historical OpenPI and RoboLab commits.
known_before_freeze.v2_a008_result: The newer current-stack wording probe returned LEFT/RIGHT action RMS 0.0.
known_before_freeze.v3_a001_result: The public 4cc config produced distinct exact-direct-command token hashes but bit-identical actions with RMS 0.0.
known_before_freeze.disclosure: This is a post-result config-isolation diagnostic, not preregistration, exact historical recovery, replication, or a hidden extension.

candidate_selection.evidence: The committed historical readiness record explicitly names policy_config pi0_fast_droid_jointpos. Public OpenPI commit 235044e is the latest reachable revision that registers that exact old name and its 10x8 SimpleDataConfig semantics.
candidate_selection.selection_limit: V3-A002 is the final public-revision diagnostic. If it fails, no further revision or seed probing is authorized by this amendment.

source_relationship_to_v3_a001.material_probe_difference: The old-name config uses the default 250-token FAST context; V3-A001 used 180. The data-config class also differs, but both use the same DROID input and absolute-action output transforms for this observation.
source_relationship_to_v3_a001.checkpoint_timing_warning: The checkpoint metadata dates to April 2025 and public commit 235044e dates to December 2025. The public config is therefore a compatibility candidate, not the checkpoint's proven training revision.

checkpoint.asset_rule: Use and hash checkpoint-local assets/droid/norm_stats.json only.

prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

required_pass: exact bridge commit, tree, config, token length, asset rule, prompt hashes, and sampling seed attested
LEFT and repeated LEFT token bytes and actions bit-identical
LEFT and RIGHT tokenized prompt hashes differ
LEFT and RIGHT action hashes differ
LEFT versus RIGHT action RMS greater than zero

behavioral_release_if_gate_passes.rule: Release all 40 cells exactly once only after every model-blind check and this exact three-request gate pass.

failure_rule: If the gate fails, run zero V3-A002 behavioral cells, preserve the diagnostic, stop public-revision probing, and leave the exact historical revisions as the only route to extend the historical cohort.

reporting_boundary.historical: Report preserved LEFT and RIGHT out of 10 under the historical identity.
reporting_boundary.v3_a001: Report only its failed nonbehavioral gate.
reporting_boundary.v3_a002: If released, report LEFT and RIGHT out of 20 under this identity.
prohibited: pooled confidence intervals or tests across runtime identities
calling V3-A002 checkpoint-era code or recovered historical code
